answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one tundra weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 160 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 294 times the capital for one share. The pulse report reveals the merge explicitly at each voyage. A farm of 1710 identities would post 2605 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
